notes.trap: `CAST(... AS STRING)` on a struct drops the field names and prints only the values in curly braces, e.g. `{1, x}`. It does not produce a JSON-like `{"a":1,...}`, even though the docs display struct results that way. Use `to_json(...)` to get a string that keeps the field names.

Field names are not always `col1`, `col2`, .... When an argument is a column reference or an aliased expression, its name becomes the field name. Only unnamed expressions such as literals get the positional `colN` name, based on the argument's position.
notes.example_sql: SELECT typeof(struct(x, 2)) FROM VALUES (1) AS t(x)
